trust_boundaries: The default public product is a transparent state-transition receipt service.
Do not put secrets, private customer data, or API keys into transparent receipt parameters.
Private-input language requires a separately documented template, explicit review status, and supported verifier path.
External cryptographer audit is pending; live self-serve exposure is limited to documented production templates.
